science.qualification: An estimate, not a measurement: the color of a black body at the equilibrium temperature 2,562 K (Zhou et al. 2019, equilibrium temperature (NASA Exoplanet Archive planetary systems table)), uniform over the disc. On 120 hot Jupiters whose day side Spitzer measured, the measured temperature is within 20% of this kind of estimate for 83% (Deming et al. 2023).

metadata.limbMeaning: The adopted source-radius opaque-sphere silhouette and prepared phase lighting define the limb; no atmospheric rim is inferred.
